# Upstream material

- `figures4papers/`: original Chen Liu example code and its CC BY-NC 4.0 license.
  Source: https://github.com/ChenLiu-1996/figures4papers
- `bbplot-data-viz/`: the earlier BBC/ggplot investigation and its recorded source
  references, retained separately from the Python plotting package.

The root MIT license covers this repository's original library and templates.
It does not replace the licenses or attribution attached to upstream material or
reference datasets. The installable package contains the original plotting
helpers and style settings; upstream example code is not included in the wheel.
